verdict.rationale: Graphite's pricing page lists an 'Automations' feature, but no document describes how it works. The closest documented event-triggered behaviour is the Graphite Agent automatically reviewing every new PR in selected repos, backed by GitHub webhooks for CI, mergeability and push events. Custom review rules are guidance for the agent rather than event-to-action triggers. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined trigger/condition/action rules, the list of supported events and actions, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
